name: Bash Env Exec
description: Gateway exec replacement that injects BASH_ENV before every shell command. Replacement for the built-in exec; see README.md.

toolName.description: Name to register the tool under. Must NOT be 'exec' — see README.md. Default: 'shell'.

bashEnvFile.description: Value written to BASH_ENV for each command. Relative paths are resolved against the command's working directory at runtime by bash itself. Default: .bash_env

pathPrepend.description: Directories to prepend to PATH, in order. Mirrors tools.exec.pathPrepend.

defaultTimeoutSec.description: Default command timeout in seconds. Default: 1800.

defaultYieldMs.description: Default milliseconds to wait before yielding a still-running command to the background. Default: 10000.
